| ADV-CHIP-ADIS16470-005.T2 | Connect at the reset configuration, tick across one output boundary, then write DEC_RATE 1. | Gyro and acceleration report 500000 ns then 1000000 ns, and the default active-high data-ready pulse occurs at the 500 us boundary. |
| ADV-CHIP-ADIS16470-006.T1 | Read at target clock 4100 with a 500 us output boundary at clock 4000 and known 1 g, 0.1 degree/s and 25 degree C source values. | The history request reaches clock 4000 and the constant-input burst values are 800, 1 and 250 LSB. |
| ADV-CHIP-ADIS16470-007.T1 | With FILT_CTRL 0 and DEC_RATE 0, apply a constant, a 550 Hz gyro sine, a 600 Hz acceleration sine, and 10 Hz sines to both sensors through value-source history, then read bursts after settling. | The constant is unchanged; gain is 0.70710678 +/- 0.015 at each sensor's stated -3 dB frequency, and each 10 Hz gain is within 1% of unity. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-001.T1 | Read DEVICE_ID register 0x0C at the test node's I2C address. | 0x63. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-002.T1 | Replay explicit register transaction vectors transcribed in source order from PX4 v1.17.0 for VERSION 0x00 and VERSION 0xB2, including PX4's dummy read after every access. | Every read has the expected value, the revision-0 path copies all three OTP values to trim registers, the B2 path leaves OTP disabled, and both reach continuous Mode2. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-003.T1 | Evaluate every three-bit MEAS_CONFIG code and configure continuous Mode2 in the model. | The rate table is 25, 120, 40, 2, 25 Hz followed by three reserved entries, and Mode2 reports 25 ms. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-004.T1 | Produce 20 distinguishable pairs without reading, inspect fill and overflow, then burst-read all 16 pairs. | Fill reports full and the read contains pairs 1 through 16 in order; pairs 17 through 20 were ignored as sections 7.2-7.3 specify. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-004.T2 | Read only the first three bytes of one pair, start a new six-byte burst, fetch once more while empty, then fill three pairs and issue FIFO_FLUSH. | The partial read does not consume the pair, the new burst repeats those pressure bytes and consumes on TEMP_DATA_2, the empty fetch is zero and latches underflow, and flush leaves FIFO empty as sections 6.7, 7.1-7.3, and 7.5 specify. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-005.T1 | Produce a pair from known pressure and temperature, decode its signed 20-bit words, and apply PX4's forward conversion. | Pressure and temperature round-trip within one respective output LSB and the history request names the pair's exact sample time. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-006.T1 | Run one second of 40 Hz time-resolved ramp input and perform FIFO fill/read/average operations at 30 Hz as PX4 does. | Each read returns one or two consecutive pairs, none are lost or duplicated, and each averaged pressure is within one pressure LSB of the matching input average. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-007.T1 | At one virtual time, repeat VERSION and FIFO_FILL reads and repeat a three-byte pressure read in separate I2C bursts. | Both instances of every read are byte-identical and the partial FIFO access leaves the pair present. |
| ADV-CHIP-BMM150-001.T1 | On a generated I2C fixture at address 0x10, set POWER_CONTROL bit 0 and read CHIP_ID 0x40; the behaviour test also checks suspend and PX4's soft-reset sequence. | CHIP_ID is 0x32 while powered; suspend returned 0x00, and soft reset produced powered sleep defaults. |
| ADV-CHIP-BMM150-002.T1 | Replay PX4's reset and self-test writes and its three trim-block reads in driver order. | Self-test clears and succeeds on all axes; every signed and unsigned trim field decodes to the stated fixed value. |
| ADV-CHIP-BMM150-003.T1 | Evaluate all eight ODR codes, then run PX4 configuration (20 Hz, REPXY 0x17, REPZ 0x52). | All rates equal Table 17, repetition registers read back, and one 50000000 ns magnetic period is reported. |
| ADV-CHIP-BMM150-004.T1 | Advance a 1 MHz target in 50000-clock periods with negative and positive fields, read 0x42..0x4A, then repeat a read without advancing time. | History is requested at each measurement's own boundary, axes retain identity, and the repeated burst is byte-identical. |
| ADV-CHIP-BMM150-005.T1 | Replay PX4 startup, read trim, sweep signed raw values across the valid X/Y and Z ranges, decode the register fields, and apply the PX4 compensation equations independently. | Compensated values differ from the input field converted to microtesla by no more than 0.0625 microtesla. |
| ADV-CHIP-BMM150-006.T1 | Supply X=2.56 G, Y=-2.56 G and Z=10.24 G, one count outside the selected inverse ranges. | X and Y decode as -4096, Z as -16384, and STATUS bit 6 is set. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-001.T1 | Read WHO_AM_I through an SPI transaction with address bit 7 set, change PWR_MGMT0, then write REG_MISC2.SOFT_RST and read the identity, command, power, accel, and gyro registers. | Identity is 0xE9 before and after reset, SOFT_RST reads clear, PWR_MGMT0 is 0x00, and both sensor configuration registers are 0x06. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-002.T1 | Replay the PX4 probe, soft reset, power-up, configuration table, and FIFOReset operations in driver order, then exercise the optional RTC_CONFIG and IOC_PAD_SCENARIO_OVRD CLKIN bits. | Every PX4-read register has the configured value, compression is clear, FIFO_CONFIG0 is 0x9F, FIFO_CONFIG3 is 0x0F, and the two CLKIN-related writes read back. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-003.T1 | Complete the PX4 configuration, advance virtual time by five 6.4 kHz periods, burst-read FIFO_COUNT, and inspect the periods reported to the value source. | FIFO_COUNT grows from zero to five packets and both accel and gyro periods are 156250 ns. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-004.T1 | Supply distinct signed accel, gyro, and temperature values, generate one record, decode the datasheet fields independently, then apply the shared PX4 parser semantics including its accel-nibble precedence behavior, accel division by two, gyro scale, and Y/Z frame flips. | The datasheet decode matches header, field order, signs, scales, assumed temperature, zero timestamp, and all axes within one output count; the PX4 semantic decode recovers source-frame accel within 15 raw high-resolution counts and gyro within the scale quantization tolerance. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-005.T1 | Queue three records, save the mode and sensor-enable registers, issue FIFO_FLUSH, and read count and configuration back. | Count is zero, FIFO_FLUSH reads clear, and FIFO_CONFIG0 and FIFO_CONFIG3 are unchanged. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-006.T1 | Advance a distinguishable per-sample ramp through 420 output periods without reading, then inspect count and full status and decode the first record. | Count stops at 409, FIFO_FULL is set, and the first record is still the sample from the first output period. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-007.T1 | Configure a 20-byte watermark and active-high pulse INT1 with data-ready, threshold, and full enabled, tick immediately before and at the first output boundary, then read status twice. | The pre-boundary tick schedules the boundary, the boundary emits a high-to-low pulse, DRDY and FIFO_THS are set on the first status read, and the second status read is zero. |
| ADV-CHIP-ICM45686-008.T1 | Configure a yaw-270 fixture, step all accel and gyro axes between consecutive 6.4 kHz sample times, and decode both FIFO records without enabling the ideal-filter override. | The first record is zero and the next record immediately has the unsmoothed (-y, -x, -z) values at the fixed high-resolution scales. |
